label: Goats and sheep

names.text: The article gives 'goat-antelopes' as a name for members of the subfamily Caprinae, which is wider than this tribe, and says sheep and goats are its best-known members. 'Goats and sheep' is the item's given label.

sources.text: Tribe Caprini within the subfamily Caprinae (J. E. Gray, 1821), as listed in the article's genus table. The article also says Caprinae is 'sometimes referred to as the tribe Caprini'; that alternate usage is not followed here.

about.text: The tribe of goats and sheep, with the genera Capra (goats) and Ovis (sheep) among its genera in the article. Goats and sheep are the next two species for milk after cattle and water buffalo.

links.name: FAOSTAT: Crops and livestock products (QCL), world, 2023

sources.text: Genus membership is from the Wikipedia article's species table as fetched. The ranking rests on FAOSTAT 2023 milk tonnes in research/herd/faostat-2023.json: cattle 785.84 and water buffalo 150.69 million t are the largest; goat 20.84 and sheep 9.97 million t come next, ahead of camels at 4.08 million t.

gaps: The tribe's full milk total was not computed; the species records carry the figures. The article's species table is not reproduced in full here.
